card.title: You have one minute to prepare.

bubbles.t: Starting next month, you can work from home.

card.start: One day, a woman was talking with her coworkers in the office.

steps.t: Hello. My name is Ms. Brown. May I have your name, please?
Thank you. This is the Grade Pre-1 test. First, please tell me about yourself.
I see. What do you like to do in your free time?
Thank you. Now, let's start the test. Here is your card.
You have one minute to prepare. This is a story about a woman who started working from home. Your story should begin with the sentence on the card.
All right. Please begin your narration. You have two minutes.
Now, I'll ask you four questions.
Number 1. Please look at the fourth picture. If you were the woman, what would you be thinking?
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 2. Do you think companies should allow more employees to work from home?
Number 3. Should the government do more to support small businesses in rural areas?
Number 4. These days, many people read the news on their smartphones. Do you think people trust the news less than they did in the past?
This is the end of the test. Could I have the card back, please?
Thank you. You may go now.

free1.ja: 自己紹介をしてください。
model: I'm a high school student. I'm interested in airplanes, and I want to become an airline pilot in the future.

free2.q: What do you like to do in your free time?
free2.ja: 自由な時間に何をするのが好きですか。
model: I like riding my bike. On weekends, I often ride to the airport to watch planes.

narr.ja: 4コマのイラストの話を、カードの最初の文から2分で説明してください。
model: One day, a woman was talking with her coworkers in the office. Her boss said to them, "Starting next month, you can work from home." The woman looked happy to hear this. A month later, she was working on her computer at home. She was drinking coffee, and her dog was sitting next to her. A few weeks later, there was construction work near her house. It was very noisy, and she couldn't concentrate on her work. The next week, she was working at the office again, and she was talking with her boss.
points: 4コマすべて + コマ間の言葉(A month later など)
吹き出しのセリフ・表情も説明
1分の準備で各コマ1〜2文を決める

q1.q: If you were the woman, what would you be thinking?
q1.ja: あなたがこの女性だったら、何を考えているでしょうか。
model: I'd be thinking, "Working from home was comfortable, but it's easier to concentrate at the office. Maybe I should come to the office on some days."

q2.q: Do you think companies should allow more employees to work from home?
q2.ja: 会社はもっと多くの社員に在宅勤務を認めるべきだと思いますか。
model: Yes. Employees can save time because they don't have to commute. As a result, they may have more energy for their work and their families.
points: 意見 + 理由 + 結果(As a result)

q3.q: Should the government do more to support small businesses in rural areas?
q3.ja: 政府は地方の小さな会社をもっと支援すべきですか。
model: Yes. Small businesses create jobs for local people. If they close, young people will move to big cities, and rural areas will become even smaller.

q4.q: Do you think people trust the news less than they did in the past?
q4.ja: 人々は昔よりニュースを信頼しなくなったと思いますか。
model: Yes. There is a lot of false information on the Internet. It is sometimes hard for people to tell which news is true.
points: 前置きの文(These days, …)を受けて答える
